[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Cherry pickup** [LC 741 · Cherry Pickup](https://leetcode.com/problems/cherry-pickup/){difficulty="Hard"}

Read the return trip backwards and it is a second right/down walk from the start to the corner, on the same cells. The score depends only on the set of cells, so the round trip is two forward walkers. They can share a cell only at the tick $t = r + c$, which in the state is the test $r_1 = r_2$. That is why one equality pays the cell once.

[Solved in full in @sec-gd-p4-cherry.]{.card-link}
